source: synthetic; the secret-adjacent egress shape observed across the v0.1 sweep (bundled UIs reading process.env next to fetch)
license: MIT — synthetic fixture; no upstream code copied
rationale: An undeclared outbound client grades C on its own; when a network call is statically reachable from a secret read, egress.secret-adjacent escalates to high severity at medium confidence and the grade becomes D — the one shape where co-occurrence is graded, because reachability is proven, not presumed.
limitations: Reachability from the read is not proof of exfiltration; the rule names the file, line, and host and lets the reviewer ask the question.
